current_answer: Choose by the job and the evidence path. Use OpenAI Game UI Frontend only for a browser-game HUD, menu, or overlay that must leave the playfield and input controls usable; it is a poor default for an ordinary product dashboard. Its source is mutable, its Game Studio package is currently listed as version 0.1.2 with MIT declared, and the pool did not run it. Use PaulRBerg Frontend Design when an existing or substantial screen already has a system and you need one project-bound direction held to local constraints, then rendered inspection at the states and widths that matter. Use OpenAI Product Design Ideate when you need three image-based directions for a new or redesigned screen before build work; use Frontend App Builder when you need its concept-to-browser workflow. The other lanes remain separate: Anthropic Frontend Design for text-led visual direction; PracticalSwan Frontend Design 2.0 for substantial work with an explicit state model; Wenkang Frontend Design for human visual decisions on a real route; Vercel skills for React composition, transitions, UI review, and performance; Agent Browser and Dogfood for capture and exploratory QA; Frontend Testing & Debugging for a named rendered change; and Product Design Audit for a captured flow. Eleven of fifteen listings are source-pinned. Frontend Testing & Debugging, Product Design Ideate, PaulRBerg Frontend Design, and Game UI Frontend are current mutable sources. None has been independently installed, executed, or compared on a shared frontend task by this pool.
